cohort: 220 first-time fathers who participated in childbirth at a public hospital in Talcahuano, Chile, between September 2015 and May 2016
finding: The study validated a Spanish version of the 'First Time Fathers Questionnaire', demonstrating its reliability and validity in assessing the experiences of new fathers in Latin America.
mod_finding: Father worry was significantly higher in fathers whose partners had cesarean sections.
